authKey.description:
AuthKey is a Headscale pre-auth key (single-use, tagged, short-lived) or,
with "bring your own Tailscale", the tailnet's auth key.

title: MeshAuthKey: plaintext sealed into NodeState system.tailscale.authKey (crypto_box_seal)
description: MeshAuthKey is the plaintext of NodeState.system.tailscale.authKey: libsodium crypto_box_seal of this JSON object to the daemon's X25519 key.
